notes: Born 12 Nov 1899 in South Dakota, son of Meinik Falde and Berthine Engebretson; at school in Virginia Township, Union County, in 1913–14; married Gertrude Lillian Whalen at Hawarden on 17 Nov 1919; farming in Virginia Township in 1930 and 1940 with Gertrude and Roger; died 15 Jan 1993 at Hawarden and was buried at Grace Hill (marriage record; censuses; SSDI; Find a Grave). His sister was Belle Delia Falde (Thompson, 1897–1970).
